rules.reason: The source contains uint32 maximum (4294967295), scaled by 0.1, while its advertised nodata is 2147483647. This is not a plausible precipitation total. The provider's missingness mechanism is unconfirmed; mark an invalid source value, not a known biological zero.

Two values reach the uint16 storage ceiling (65535 times 0.1); their GSP totals exceed this annual precipitation value. Clipping is plausible, but a true annual amount is not recovered. Treat this source-ceiling value as unresolved, not a measured exact value or confirmed missing code.

operation: Keep the original matrix immutable. In a separate QC view, preserve every row and all raw columns, add original-value and reason columns for the two variables, and set only the flagged working values to missing. No imputation or percentile winsorization.
prior_selection: The preliminary raw-matrix candidate_process_selection.json is retained as a rejected computational result. Its low GSP VIF reflected invalid finite values and cannot be adopted.
remaining: Rerun the same candidate selector without changing thresholds or protected processes. This QC view does not activate an ecological model; nuisance-adjusted, within/among and measurement-support diagnostics remain required.
